title: Nice nautical print..but not anti skid.
text:
Nice nautical print..but not anti skid.. The print is nice..that's all..came through with permanent folds... no way were they anti skid. My fan kept blowing them off the table. Nothing durable about this lightweight cheap burlap material. A little better than paper towels
material. Sending back
